prompt_text:
TRUE chunky pixel art sprite strip ONLY. Four idle frames of a small fantasy MINER in one horizontal row, facing RIGHT.

**Canvas:** very wide panoramic strip — aspect ratio roughly 3:1 (much wider than tall). The four frames must fill most of the width.

Each frame on an exact **16×24 logical pixel grid rendered large** — every logical pixel is one clean flat square block. No anti-aliasing, blur, gradient, or dithering.

Miner: feet planted on the bottom row, subtle breathing idle only — the **pose barely changes**.

**IMPORTANT — each frame uses a DIFFERENT COLOR SCHEME.** Frame 0: green tunic, blue helmet. Frame 1: red tunic, yellow helmet. Frame 2: purple tunic, white helmet. Frame 3: orange tunic, black helmet. Same shape, completely different colors each frame.

Between each frame: **two full magenta logical cells** of empty gutter (no character pixels in gutter columns).

Flat solid **magenta `#ff00ff`** background everywhere else. Selective 1px dark outline.

Frame order left→right: idle_0, idle_1, idle_2, idle_3.

Do not add margins, labels, numbers, or extra rows. One row of four frames only.
